column1: # Ash Jenna glimpsed in the Lamakan Desert after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3:
You search every face
hoping to find her.
How tiresome.{page_break}I remember that
kind of hope.{end_wait}
You look like Jenna.\nBut that can't be...\nWho are you?{end_wait}

I kept looking, too.
Until I saw what
hope was worth.{page_break}Now I take what
I came for.{end_wait}
Keep chasing them.\nYou may live long\nenough to regret it.{end_wait}
She looked like Jenna.\nBut that smile...\nIt wasn't hers.{end_wait}
